rules.bars: hourly; stop before take-profit in a bar; open beyond a level fills at the open
rules.null: same rule from random hourly starts within +/-30d, excluding the call's own reach
rules.dedup: one open position per coin; a call while one is open is skipped
rules.split: design = calls before the median call time, test = after; fixed before scoring
rules.matched: other perps at the call hour with |run-up - call run-up| <= max(3pp, 25%), call run-up >= 5%
rules.history: perp hours with 24h run-up >= 15%, 2021-01-01 to the day before the sample
